sources.title: Xerochrysum
sources.clean:
Xerochrysum (syn. Bracteantha) is a genus of flowering plants native to Australia. It was described by Russian botanist Nikolai Tzvelev in 1990, preceding (and taking precedence over) Bracteantha which was described the following year. {{Multiple image | align= left | image1= Xerochrysum bracteatum cultivar.jpg | caption1= Cultivar of
''[[Xerochrysum bracteatum]]'' | width1= 128 | image2= Xerochrysum viscosum flowers and leaves.jpg | caption2= ''[[Xerochrysum viscosum]]'' Sticky Everlasting | width2= 228 | image3= Xerochrysum bicolor-Tasmania.jpg | caption3= ''[[Xerochrysum bicolor]]'' | width3= 175 | image4 = Xerochrysum palustra.jpg|alt=Xerochrysum palustre | caption4 = ''[[Xerochrysum palustre]]'' | width4 = 77 }} {{Clear|left}} Species This genus and its species names were formerly included in Bracteantha and before that in Helichrysum. {{As of|2024|September}} the authoritative Australian Plant Census recognises thirteen formally named species and five accepted species awaiting formal naming, description and publication: Xerochrysum alpinum {{au|Paul G.Wilson}} – Tasmania Xerochrysum bicolor {{Au|(Lindl.) R.J.Bayer}} – Tasmania Xerochrysum boreale {{au|Paul G.Wilson}} – WA, NT, Qld Xerochrysum bracteatum {{Au|(Vent.) Tzvelev}}, strawflower or golden everlasting – NSW, Vic, Tas, SA, Qld, NT, WA Xerochrysum collierianum {{Au|A.M.Buchanan}} – Tasmania Xerochrysum halmaturorum {{au|Paul G.Wilson}} – SA Xerochrysum interiore {{au|Paul G.Wilson}} – WA, NT, SA Xerochrysum macranthum {{au|Paul G.Wilson}} – WA Xerochrysum macsweeneyorum {{au|T.L.Collins}} - NSW, Qld Xerochrysum milliganii {{au|Paul G.Wilson}} – Tasmania Xerochrysum palustre {{Au|(Flann) R.J.Bayer}}, swamp everlasting, syn.: Bracteantha sp. aff. subundulata – Vic, Tas Xerochrysum papillosum {{Au|(Labill.) R.J.Bayer}} – Vic, Tas Xerochrysum subundulatum {{Au|(Sch.Bip.) R.J.Bayer}}, alpine everlasting or orange everlasting – NSW, ACT, Vic, Tas Xerochrysum viscosum {{Au|(Sieber ex DC.) R.J.Bayer}}, sticky everlasting – NSW, ACT, Qld, Vic Species provisionally named, described and accepted by the authoritative Australian Plant Name Index while awaiting formal publication Xerochrysum sp. Glencoe (M.Gray 4401) NE Herbarium – Qld, NSW Xerochrysum sp. Mt Merino [Lamington National Park] (S.T.Blake 22869) NE Herbarium – Qld, NSW Xerochrysum sp. New England (L.M.Copeland 3731) NE Herbarium – NSW Xerochrysum sp. North Stradbroke Island (L.Durrington 675) NE Herbarium – Qld, NSW Xerochrysum sp. Point Lookout (I.R.Telford 12830) NE Herbarium – NSW A large scale molecular study conducted in 2022 expands the number of Xerochrysum species to 24, but as of 2024 has not been used for the Australian Plant Census.
